mintAuthority.summary: Native deposit ICLs on Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Base hold MINTER_ROLE on their local reUSD token and remain upgradeable. Checked token admin/upgrader roles are held by each chain's two-day timelock, not the 3-of-5 Safe. The Avalanche and Arbitrum Safes additionally retain ICL DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, an immediate authorization bypass; checked Ethereum and Base Safe ICL admin/upgrader roles are false. The Ethereum Safe's historical direct token-admin assignment was revoked on 2026-08-12. CCIP pool mint authority remains under Bridge Risk; the reviewed native paths retain unbounded economic-cap semantics and non-exhaustive role-inventory caveats.

controls.label: reUSD InsuranceCapitalLayer MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.capDescription: The verified InsuranceCapitalLayer mints reUSD shares only after supported collateral is transferred in and share conversion checks pass. Its own UUPS upgrader role is held by the same two-day timelock that controls reUSD.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095799, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) on reUSD is true for this ICL; its implementation slot resolves to verified InsuranceCapitalLayer 0x06d4acc104b974cd99bf22e4572f48a051e59670. The source transfers supported collateral before shareToken.mint(). Checked ICL UPGRADER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE reads are true for the two-day timelock and false for the governance Safe. Current issuer documentation still describes a Safe ICL-admin bypass, which conflicts with these address-specific reads; no exhaustive current ICL role-holder inventory is asserted.

controls.label: reUSD InstantRedemption MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) is true at Ethereum block 26095799. The re-fetched verified immutable InstantRedemption source exposes redemption and burn flows and no ShareToken mint call. The role assignment therefore is not a callable mint surface in this implementation.

controls.label: reUSD token admin and UUPS upgrader timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095799, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE) are true for this timelock and false for the governance Safe; getMinDelay() is 172800 seconds. The indexed token RoleRevoked event at block 25739457 records removal of the Safe's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on 2026-08-12, and the indexed post-baseline RoleGranted query through block 26095799 contains no new grants. Verified ShareToken source gates role grants by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UUPS replacement by UPGRADER_ROLE. This corrects the stale immediate token-admin bypass claim without asserting that every other native deployment or ICL path is fully reviewed.

controls.label: reUSD governance Safe (timelock proposer)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095799, Safe RPC calls return threshold 3, the same five owners, and no enabled modules; the Safe API confirms version 1.4.1 and zero guard. The Safe no longer holds token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE or UPGRADER_ROLE. It holds the checked PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE on timelock 0x69ddea332723cf5407151aaf68b9b076557fca93, whose delay is 172800 seconds, so its reviewed native token-authorization path is timelocked. The former direct admin assignment is retained in the review's historical explanation.

review.evidence: Historical Ethereum review through block 25712112 found the ICL and burn-only InstantRedemption roles plus a direct Safe token-admin assignment; indexed RoleRevoked at block 25739457 removed that Safe assignment. Pinned current reads verify native deposit ICL MINTER_ROLE on Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Base. Each checked token admin/upgrader assignment is held by a two-day timelock, not the Safe. The Avalanche and Arbitrum Safes still hold ICL DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, retaining the documented authorization bypass; checked Ethereum and Base Safe ICL admin/upgrader reads are false. Native controls and local proxy implementation slots are recorded above, but no exhaustive role-holder inventory, universal timelock protection or hard economic cap is claimed. Daily TNF observations cover aggregate offchain reserve balances; the historical 2025-10-31 full AUP expressly excludes token backing and NAV reconciliation. Those observations do not prove a reUSD-specific offchain denominator. The binding purchase agreement identifies Resilience (BVI) Ltd as token issuer, distinct from the Cayman foundation operating the protocol and the regulated reinsurer.
